reviewer: sf2_semantics_review agent (static comparison against sealed SF8/SF7/SF6/SF2)
scope: Static review of SF9 CONTROLLER/CURRICULUM/PREFLIGHT/BUILD/LAUNCH/REPORTER against the sealed SF8 CONTROLLER and frozen SF2_ENGINE.
findings: SF9 CONTROLLER.py preserves SF8's low-arm objective verbatim: factual full-vocab CE over answer+EOS + lambda=1.0 KL + lambda_margin=0.25 * mean(max(0, 1.0-gap)) on the first answer name token, with constant English LR 5e-5, AdamW(.9,.999,eps1e-8,wd.05), clip 2.0, unchanged PINNED_MASKING scope, unchanged binding rehearsal (LAM 1.0536573711078283) and KL pool (160 positions). The ONLY scientific change is the curriculum: TRAIN.json now contains 144 items = original 16 TRAIN16 (preserved) + 64 new surface-form items + 64 new competing-order items generated by the deterministic CURRICULUM.py using NEW objects/verbs disjoint from all frozen transfer panels (verified by substring disjointness in the generator and preflight), with correct-answer name frequency balanced 32/name and directions/orders/queries balanced. Parent = distinct SF8 lambda=0.25 checkpoints by fixed seed mapping, weights loaded with a FRESH optimizer (no SF8 optimizer state carried). gates() adds only NEW development gates (dev_surface, dev_order) at endpoint, and requires TRAIN16 acquisition + language + D3 + binding to remain green (retention regression stop). No margin is used as a gate. Transfer/frozen panels are not referenced in any training source; the post-treatment frozen-panel re-evaluation is preregistered as a separate read-only step.
limitations: N=3 parent replications; no population claim. Dev gates are prospective and ambitious; a clean failure is informative.
root_addendum: Confirmed curriculum vocab (tin cup/wool hat/green ball/silver bell, painted/dropped/bought/held; dev clay mug/brass key, stacked/rolled) is disjoint from the frozen panels' vocab (small drum/wooden boat/soft scarf/round plate, found/carried), so the new material does not copy or paraphrase any frozen panel item. No gate change, no architecture change, no tokenizer change, no dose change.
